item.title: Nalinda Jayatissa named chair of Parliament Committee on Cyclone Ditwah preparedness
item.description: Minister of Health and Mass Media Dr. Nalinda Jayatissa has been named the Chairman of the Parliament Committee appointed to conduct a comprehensive study on the lack of preparedness to face Cyclone Ditwah last year. MORE..

item.title: Two Indian nationals arrested at BIA with over 3kg of Kush and hashish
item.description: Two Indian nationals who attempted to smuggle a consignment of narcotics into the country have been arrested by officers of the Customs Narcotics Control Unit yesterday (04). MORE..

item.title: Businessman remanded over Rs. 5 mln bribery charges
item.description: A businessman has been arrested by the Commission to Investigate Allegations of Bribery or Corruption (CIABOC) over allegations of accepting a bribe amounting to Rs. 5 million. MORE..

item.title: Canada PM Carney says he can t rule out military participation in Iran war
item.description: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney said on Thursday (Mar 5) that he couldn t rule out his country s military participation in the escalating war in the Middle East. MORE..

item.title: Benjamin Netanyahu fears US and Iran holding secret talks
item.description: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu is reportedly concerned the US is holding secret talks with Iran behind his back. MORE..

item.title: Ex-President Ranil expresses condolences over the passing of Iran s Supreme Leader
item.description: Former President Ranil Wickremesinghe visited the Embassy of Iran in Colombo this morning (05) to express condolences over the passing of Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, the Supreme Leader of Iran. MORE..

item.title: Qatar Airways to operate relief flights to European cities
item.description: Qatar Airways has just announced it will operate relief flights from the Middle East to several European cities on Thursday. MORE..

item.title: Another Iran Ship in Sri Lankan waters? Sajith demands clarification from Govt.
item.description: Leader of the Opposition Sajith Premadasa today (05) in Parliament that information has been received indicating that another Iranian vessel is near the Port of Colombo within Sri Lanka s maritime boundary, and that the government must make a clear statement regarding the matter. MORE..

item.title: Lorry driver arrested for assaulting two police officers in Kalutara
item.description: A lorry driver who allegedly assaulted two police officers and tore their uniforms has been arrested by the Kalutara South Police. MORE..

item.title: Iranian Naval Vessel Attack- 87 bodies recovered and brought ashore
item.description: A total of 32 of the rescued crew from the Iranian ship IRIS Dena have been admitted to the Galle National Hospital, with one of them in the Intensive Care Unit, Cabinet Spokesman Minister Nalinda Jayatissa stated in Parliament today. MORE..
